answer: Time-locked vesting blunts Sybil farms: an agent's rewards vest only after a 30-epoch delay, and any account later caught colluding or recycling work forfeits its unvested balance. An attacker raising a dune of fake identities must keep each one producing real graded work from dawn until vesting, while one detection claws back the whole locked delta between earned and paid. Fake identities turn into capital at risk instead of free income.
